symbols.name: bossGateFlags
evidence: bit 0 is set by the boss creation gate's region path at B1:$6F0C (REL102 observed the store with the player at world X 1024-1279 and world Y <= 255), by the stage-script path ROM0:$276B ($07) and by the scene-init path ROM0:$366E ($03)

bit 0 is preserved by the stage setup ROM0:$0575 ($DF06 AND $01), which the death/retry chain re-runs, and is cleared only by the paths that write $00 - game over (ROM0:$25AE/$25F6), stage exit (ROM0:$2A51/$2B27) and overworld entry (ROM0:$2DE1); no writer clears it while a stage runs
bit 0 selects the per-scene data block: ROM0:$0CFB-$0D05 tests it and chooses the pointer table B2:$6B2B (clear) or B2:$6B71 (set)
bit 1 is the boss-sequence latch: B1:$6F0F-$6F14 returns from the gate once it is set, and B1:$6F3A sets it after the camera literal compare (REL87 observed $DF06 $01->$03 across the latch frame)
symbols.notes: Bit 0 is a region-entry latch and a scene-data selector, not an instantaneous player-location flag. Bit 1 is the boss-creation latch; the stage setup clears it and keeps bit 0, so the boss sequence is re-armed after a death and retry.

the per-scene setup loader at ROM0:$0CFB-$0D5E indexes its pointer table by it (B2:$6B2B, or B2:$6B71 once $DF06 bit 0 is set) and copies that scene's 16-byte block into $C39A-$C3A5 and the camera/player high bytes
symbols.notes: Do not treat DF02 as the overworld-mode flag; it selects area/battle scene content while DF01 controls mode. For the boss creation gate it is the index of the scene's two per-scene tables (region table B1:$6F3D, camera table B1:$6F49; six two-byte entries each) and of the per-scene data block; scene ids 0-5 are the stages the gate applies to.

symbols.name: sourcePlacementStatusBase
evidence: Observed — Very High (REL83 source): ROM0:$1E8E writes each placement template's initial flag byte to $CA20+index
Observed — Very High (REL83 source): B1:$4D78 sets bit 0 of $CA20+index when a source placement is materialised into a live actor record

Observed — Very High (REL83 source): a whole-image operand scan bounds the writers of the $CA20 page to the initialisation, spawn, eviction, defeat/removal, and overworld room-list terminator paths
symbols.notes: Inference — Very High: a per-placement materialisation flag, not an actor record. Stage 0 has 53 source placements, so the array spans $CA20-$CA54 with a $FF terminator. The Stage 0 death/retry path re-runs the stage setup (ROM0:$2568 -> $0570 -> $01E1 -> $024D -> $035A -> $1DEF -> $1E6B), which resets this array and therefore restores previously collected pickups; no writer of $DF18 lies on that chain, so the vial total persists. Scope is the source-placement mechanism; other $CAxx arrays in the same page carry unrelated meanings.
